summary: Omeros Corp (issuer) filed an 8-K reporting privately negotiated repurchases of its 9.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2029. The company agreed to repurchase up to $16.0 million aggregate principal amount for a total purchase price of up to $34.0 million, inclusive of accrued interest and other obligations, subject to adjustment based on the company's stock trading price during an averaging period starting June 18, 2026. The repurchases are expected to close between July 6 and July 16, 2026. After the repurchase, approximately $54.8 million in aggregate principal will remain outstanding. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The transaction reduces debt overhang and interest burden; watch for completion conditions and remaining note liquidity.
